svg.title: Optimization stack
svg.desc: Model-external latency optimizations applied to realtime-voice-runtime and their current decisions.
svg.text: What we optimize when the model is the same
The model path is fixed; the measurable gains come from turn control, output budget, playback, and interruption handling.

g.text: Avoids a separate STT -> text LLM -> external TTS cascade for the default profile.
server_vad 200 ms is kept after shorter windows showed tail or cutoff risk.
one-short-sentence cap reduces spoken duration and representative tail.
10 ms callback and low-latency streams add only about 5-7 ms p50 after API audio.
Clear speaker, abort TTS, cancel Realtime response, and preserve partial context.
Aggressive local endpoint detection cut off speech or stayed slower than server VAD.

svg.text: Interpretation: the report should prove model-external latency discipline, not claim that a public repo with the same model must be slower.
